title: Cortex ExecutionReceipt (v1)
description: The single wire shape for a finished dispatched task, posted to agent-fabric POST /receipts and broadcast on GET /events as receipt.created. One shape covers three producers: (1) engine-orchestrated work (agent-fabric dynamic workflow engine — ADR-0023), (2) Hermes tracked-bypass, (3) surface-direct dispatch. Per ADR-0017, only the orchestration-join fields (af_dispatch_id, af_worker_session_id, decision_id) are required for engine-orchestrated receipts; they are null/absent for bypass/direct producers. receipt_id is a CLIENT-GENERATED idempotency key, stable across outbox retries, so consumers dedupe safely. v1 supersedes the v0 draft (which over-constrained: every field required + additionalProperties:false, which forbade both the dispatch block and Hermes-bypass receipts). Joins to the engine via task_id, to a Maestro RouteDecision via decision_id. Consumed by the engine grader, Maestro label/cost stats, Forge label-harvest, and all surface consumers. Bump $id on the next breaking change.

receipt_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key (ULID/UUID), created ONCE by the producer before the first POST and reused on every retry/outbox replay. Consumers dedupe on this. Servers MUST NOT regenerate it.

task_id.description: The spine task this receipt closes. UUID for spine-orchestrated tasks; for bypass/direct producers with no spine task, a producer-scoped id (still required for joins/audit).

af_dispatch_id.description: Set by agent-fabric /dispatch for spine-orchestrated work. Null for Hermes-bypass and surface-direct receipts.

af_worker_session_id.description: Set by agent-fabric for spine-orchestrated work. Null for bypass/direct receipts.

decision_id.description: Joins with RouteDecision.decision_id when the model call was routed through Maestro. Null otherwise.

cost.description: Best-effort cost/usage; null if the executor does not report it.

result_pointer.description: Where the result lives, e.g. mnemos://<container>/<memory_id>, s3://..., file:///..., or a repo/branch ref.

dispatch.description: Optional. Present for surface-originated work (pocket-agent, PLO, fleet-terminal, hermes). Absorbs the pocket-agent dispatch fields so a single receipt shape flows everywhere; never the receipt bus for conversation turns (those go to Mnemos only).
